response.sql: SELECT AVG(length) AS avg_length, AVG(replacement_cost / rental_rate) AS avg_ratio FROM film WHERE length >= 112

assumptions.assumption: A 'long film' has length >= 112 minutes (films at or above the cutoff are considered long)

alternatives.interpretation: A 'long film' has length > 112 minutes (strictly longer than the cutoff, excluding films exactly at 112 minutes)
